body.p: The shell. Long ago, in this land there lived a rich human. There came a devil. The devil [DCh]: Why came, it made a hole, it looked at the human. The devil thought: "I'll eat this rich human."prolative case at "bajÉli"? The rich human saw the hole. Then he put a shell into the hole. The devil went into the earth forever. Now it is a sin to kill a shell. This(?) shell, it is a human. A bad person killed a shell. After this human had killed the shell, having killed it he died. There are such stories.
